steps.en: Install the skill + design hook into the harnesses it detects
steps.zh: 一条命令把 skill 和设计 hook 装进它检测到的 harness

steps.en: Run once per project; it records durable product truth in PRODUCT.md
steps.zh: 每个项目跑一次，把产品事实沉淀进 PRODUCT.md

steps.en: Fetches the self-contained engine binary once — no LLM, no API key
steps.zh: 首次取回一次自包含引擎二进制——无 LLM、无 API key

steps.en: On each direct UI-file edit the hook runs 61 deterministic rules and feeds findings back to your agent
steps.zh: 每次直接编辑 UI 文件时跑 61 条规则，把问题回灌给 agent

steps.en: Fix or restyle with the shared command vocabulary
steps.zh: 用共享命令词汇修复或重刷风格

steps.en: Gate merges in CI with the same offline engine
steps.zh: 在 CI 里用同一个离线引擎把关合并

value.en: Your agent ships UIs without the AI-slop tells — checked offline, on every edit, with no API key
value.zh: agent 交出的 UI 不再带 AI slop 特征——离线、逐次编辑、无需 API key 地检查

sources: https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable#installation (engine binary ships next to the launcher or is fetched once into ~/.impeccable/bin/)
https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable#design-hook (hook runs the detector on direct UI file edits, findings surface back into the agent flow)
https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable#cli (`npx impeccable detect --json .`, 61 deterministic rules, exit 0/2 semantics)
